name: GRID Esports
tagline: Official-grade esports data and live telemetry for major titles and broadcasters
description: GRID provides esports data and live telemetry APIs used by publishers, broadcasters, and developers for match stats, series schedules, player performance, and real-time game events across major competitive titles.

auth.details: API key via the x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY header (HTTP/GraphQL). WebSocket uses ?key= query param.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Application-based free Open Access for pre-revenue startups, students, independent developers, researchers, and fans; limited API calls; CS2/Dota 2 historical (not full commercial live feeds).
pricing.paid_plans: Commercial (betting/fantasy/media/other): contact sales for custom quote; no public list prices. Professional team portals free with premium add-ons.

example.request: curl -X POST "https://api-op.grid.gg/central-data/graphql" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY" -d '{"query":"{ teams(filter: {name: {contains: \"Team\"}}) { edges { node { id name } } } }"}'

use_cases: fetch live match telemetry for a tournament series
list upcoming esports series schedules by game title
query player or team performance stats for a completed match
subscribe to real-time in-game events for broadcast overlays
